import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.scatterplot(x='Sleep Duration', y='Quality of Sleep', 
                hue='Physical Activity Level', size='Stress Level', 
                sizes=(50, 200), alpha=0.7, data=df)
plt.axline((df['Sleep Duration'].mean(), df['Quality of Sleep'].mean()), 
           slope=0, linestyle='--', color='gray', alpha=0.5)
plt.axline((df['Sleep Duration'].mean(), df['Quality of Sleep'].mean()), 
           slope=0, linestyle='--', color='gray', alpha=0.5)
plt.title('Sleep Duration vs Quality by Activity Level & Stress')
plt.xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)')
plt.ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)')
plt.legend(title='Physical Activity Level', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
